description: Declared platform matrix for the self-contained sap-adt runtime. 'status' is maintained explicitly: 'verified-local' and 'verified-ci' require a real native build + install smoke on that OS/arch, locally or in CI respectively. Never mark a target verified from a script's existence alone.

windows-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.1 Windows x64 runtime built with Windows Python 3.12 via WSL interop on 2026-10-30; ZIP and isolated npm install passed diagnostic/debugger cross-process smokes. Inno Setup 6.7.4 desktop installer: silent per-user install, same-version upgrade, launch and uninstall verified in a Unicode/space path with the PATH task disabled; PATH cleanup helper tested separately. Windows-local npm regressions: 42 passed, 5 platform-specific skips. Interactive wizard, actual PATH mutation, elevated installation and live debugger attachment are unverified.

linux-x86_64.notes: CLI 1.6.1 verified on Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 (WSL2), 2026-10-30: Python/npm regressions, clean wheel install and native npm diagnostic/debugger cross-process smokes. glibc floor applies to other distros; do not generalize to musl/older glibc without a real build there. Live debugger attachment is unverified.

darwin-aarch64.notes: Experimental CLI 1.6.1 macOS 15+ Apple Silicon runtime, verified 2026-10-30. Native macos-15 CI with Python 3.14 passed the offline Python/npm suites, runtime build and isolated npm diagnostic/debugger cross-process smokes: Actions run 40994475197, source 26bf0580df4613803225f997abadda249601936e. No personal Mac, older macOS, live SAP, Keychain, Gatekeeper/quarantine, signing or notarization verification.
